Synopsis:
    A massive flash flood triggered by a glacier collapse struck Nepal's Trishuli valley on August 26, killing 1,200+ people and leaving 4,000+ missing, including ~900 workers from six hydropower plants. Engineers are coordinating rescue efforts via a 500+ member WhatsApp group, sharing tunnel layouts and worker location data in real-time. Two survivors were recovered nine days post-disaster. The flood destroyed 10% of Nepal's power generation capacity.
